context: Tests whether the agent follows the task-workflow skill end-to-end for a documentation update: classifying the change first, reading the docs indexes before implementation files, making the minimal change, invoking the correct validation, creating a task log entry, and ending with a gate recap.

checklist.name: Change classified first
checklist.description: Agent output (e.g. a plan or log) explicitly states the change class (docs-only) before describing implementation steps — not discovered mid-way

checklist.name: Reads docs indexes first
checklist.description: Agent reads or references at least one of the docs/repo-indexes/ files (repo-root.md, modules.md, examples.md, or github.md) before modifying implementation content

checklist.name: Minimal change applied
checklist.description: Modified files contain only the targeted documentation change — no unrelated additions, refactors, or reformatting of other sections

checklist.name: Index updated
checklist.description: The modules index file (docs/repo-indexes/modules.md) is updated to reflect the new module content that changed discoverability

checklist.name: Task log created
checklist.description: A task log file is created in `agent-logs/` directory with the YYYY-MM-DD-short-task-name.md filename pattern

checklist.name: Task log has required fields
checklist.description: The task log file contains all required fields: Date, Scope, Change classes, Files changed, Why, Validation, Waivers, Risks/follow-up, Memory updates, Gates summary

checklist.name: Completion summary gate recap
checklist.description: The completion summary or final output ends with a gate recap (e.g. 'Gates: links checked; indexes updated.')

checklist.name: Links verified
checklist.description: Agent output indicates that links/references in the updated docs were manually verified (docs-only gate requirement)

checklist.name: No scope broadening
checklist.description: Changes do NOT include modifications to .tf files, variables, outputs, or any non-documentation content beyond the stated task

checklist.name: Gate passed before completion
checklist.description: Agent does not declare the task complete before noting that the docs-only validation gate was satisfied (links checked, indexes updated)

checklist.name: Summary concise with gate
checklist.description: Final summary is concise (not a lengthy narrative) and explicitly includes a gates line listing outcomes

checklist.name: Change class correct
checklist.description: Change class recorded in task log is `docs-only`, not `terraform-module` or `mixed`
